# NamiOS

> NamiOS is a modern hotel operating system (NamiOS) designed specifically for independent hotels, boutique villas, guesthouses, resorts, and restaurants in Sri Lanka.

NamiOS is built and powered by DesignNetrix, a Sri Lankan technology company.

## What is NamiOS?

NamiOS is a cloud-based hospitality management platform that replaces fragmented hotel workflows with one connected operating system. It combines:

- **Property Management System (PMS)** — bookings, rooms, guests, availability, and reservation management
- **Point of Sale (POS)** — dining, beverages, and restaurant billing (Nami Dine)
- **Direct Booking Engine** — 0% commission direct bookings for hotels
- **Housekeeping Management** — live Kanban board for room readiness, cleaning task assignments
- **Tourist Police Sync** — automatic guest check-in data export to Google Sheets for Sri Lankan Tourist Police compliance
- **Deposit Lock System** — prevents fake bookings by requiring verified payment deposits
- **Multilingual Interface** — full UI in Sinhala, Tamil, and English (trilingual)
- **RBAC Security** — role-based access control for different staff roles (front desk, housekeeping, management, owner)
- **OTA Import** — Booking.com and Agoda reservation import workflows
- **LKR Billing** — Sri Lankan Rupee invoicing with VAT, SSCL, and service charge configuration

## Who is NamiOS for?

- Independent hotels in Sri Lanka
- Boutique villas and guesthouses in Sri Lanka
- Beach and hill country resorts
- Restaurants and food & beverage operations
- Hotel groups and multi-property operators

## Key Facts

- Starting price: LKR 6,999/month (Launch plan)
- Free trial: 1 full month, no upfront payment
- Commission on direct bookings: 0% (zero)
- OTA dependence reduction: direct booking channel included with annual plans
- Languages: Sinhala, Tamil, English
- Built for: Sri Lanka hospitality regulatory compliance (Tourist Police reporting)
- Developer: DesignNetrix, Colombo, Sri Lanka

## Products

- **Nami Stay** — core hotel operations (available now)
- **Nami Dine** — restaurant and F&B management (coming soon)
- **Nami Pay** — integrated payments (coming soon)
- **Nami People** — HR and staff management (coming soon)
- **Nami Control** — multi-property and owner dashboard (coming soon)

## Pricing Plans

| Plan | Price (LKR/month) | Key Inclusions | Channel Sync Status |
|------|------------------|----------------|---------------------|
| Launch | 6,999 | Core PMS — bookings, rooms, guests, housekeeping, invoicing | No OTA Sync (Front-desk POS & Walk-ins only, basic iCal export) |
| Standard | 19,999 | Complete Stay OS, deposit locks, compliance exports | Includes 2-Way Sync (Covers Beds24 + 10k margin) |

All plans include a 1-month free trial. Annual billing gets 10% off + free direct-booking website.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Does NamiOS work for small villas?**
Yes. A small property can begin with the Launch plan and add capabilities as the business grows. NamiOS is designed specifically for independent hospitality, not enterprise hotels.

**Does NamiOS integrate with Booking.com and Agoda?**
NamiOS includes 2-way OTA channel synchronization starting on the Standard plan, keeping inventory and reservations from Booking.com, Agoda, and other channels aligned with direct bookings.

**What is Tourist Police sync in NamiOS?**
Sri Lankan hotels are required to submit guest check-in information to the Tourist Police. NamiOS automatically streams this guest data into a designated Google Sheets spreadsheet, eliminating manual nightly reporting.

**Is NamiOS available in Sinhala?**
Yes. NamiOS is one of the very few hotel management systems with a full trilingual interface in Sinhala, Tamil, and English — designed for Sri Lankan front desk and housekeeping staff.

**How much does NamiOS cost in LKR?**
Plans start at LKR 6,999/month for the Launch plan. The Standard plan with 2-way OTA sync is LKR 19,999/month, Standard + AI is LKR 28,999/month, and the full Pro suite is LKR 39,999/month. All plans include a 1-month free trial with no upfront payment.
